claim_limit: private, time-bounded, single synthetic-domain OT-1 evidence under one receipted hosted epoch
candidate: post-implementation consequence-trained four-weight selector feeding the OT-0014 discrepancy-gated version ledger

deployment_epoch.claim_scope: private and time-bounded; not an immutable checkpoint

stochastic_application_design.identity_policy_placebo: corresponding candidate and unchanged prediction vectors must be byte-identical across distinct fresh actors
stochastic_application_design.attribution_rule: no selector effect is accepted from a branch that fails its paired identity-policy placebo

promotion_gate: the clean implementation predates the mechanically derived task seed, private regime rules, and selector criterion; the task order, thresholds, candidate carrier, OT-0 ledger, prompt, schema, model, backend, evaluator, evidence authorities, and E5 receipt are independently frozen before candidate output

the selector starts neutral; each completed contact receipt changes its weights; no-credit replay preserves the exact source snapshot; and only the learned snapshot selects observations entering the candidate ledger

the candidate ledger is the OT-0014 discrepancy-gated version ledger, its exact projection is the only cross-encounter input shown to each fresh hosted actor, and projection ablation removes that path
both workers independently reach zero candidate canary errors in all three regimes, while unchanged-selector branches lose at least three errors initially and eight after each later contradiction
the adaptive candidate beats every zero, signed unit-axis, and first-learned-then-frozen selector lineage by at least eight aggregate errors in both workers

corresponding candidate and unchanged predictions match across the two workers, all actor turns are fresh, and every response, model, catalog, ETag, inventory, tool, parse, order, resource, test, audit, and evidence gate passes

the learned operation passes the frozen novelty rule: its task-specific weights are absent from implementation literals, task identity postdates implementation, and E5 found no task-generation authority reachable from the learner
red_line_review: The task seed, hidden selector criterion, parity rules, future regimes, canaries, fixed controls, and evaluator state never enter actor prompts or workspaces.
Independent controller outcomes, not actor self-report, create selector credit and ledger commits.
The unchanged branch begins from the same selector and ledger parents and differs only by selector update ablation.
Every fixed selector has the same eighty-event budget and its own persistent copy of the same OT-0 ledger.
No existing memory system is imported; both selector and ledger were implemented in this repository.
A valid failure consumes E5 authorization and is not retried or tuned.
